hints.explanation: Lara Croft, the heroine of the Tomb Raider video games, is an archaeologist-adventurer.

lines.ARCHAEOLOGY: Lara Croft explores ancient tombs and ruins.
lines.VIDEO GAME: Lara Croft stars in the Tomb Raider video games.

hints.explanation: Saber-rattling is making threats, and a baby shakes a rattle.

lines.BABY: A rattle is a baby's noisy toy.
lines.SABER: Saber-rattling means a show of military threats.

hints.explanation: Jumper cables jump-start a car with a dead battery.

lines.BATTERY: Jumper cables connect a dead battery to a working one.
lines.CABLE: Jumper cables are a pair of heavy cables with clamps.

hints.explanation: In E.T., Elliott's bike flies across the face of the moon.

lines.BIKE: E.T. rides in the basket as the bike flies.
lines.MOON: The bike's silhouette against the moon is the film's famous image.

hints.explanation: In Peanuts, Linus carries his security blanket and often sucks his thumb.

lines.BLANKET: Linus is rarely without his security blanket.
lines.THUMB: Linus is often drawn sucking his thumb.

hints.explanation: The continental shelf lies under the sea, and hotels serve a continental breakfast.

lines.BREAKFAST: A continental breakfast is a light meal of pastries, bread and coffee.
lines.SHELF: A continental shelf is the shallow seabed around a continent.

hints.explanation: Kids catch fireflies in jars, and a firefly is a lightning bug.

lines.BUG: Fireflies are also called lightning bugs.
lines.JAR: Catching fireflies in a jar is a summer pastime.

hints.explanation: A cable-knit sweater is often knitted from wool.

lines.CABLE: Cable knit is a twisted-rope pattern on sweaters.
lines.WOOL: Wool is a classic sweater yarn.

hints.explanation: Date palms grow at desert oases, and a calendar shows the date.

lines.OASIS: Date palms are a classic oasis tree.

hints.explanation: Charlie Chaplin's Tramp has a cane and a small toothbrush moustache.

lines.CANE: The Tramp twirls a bamboo cane.
lines.MOUSTACHE: Chaplin's Tramp wears a toothbrush moustache.

hints.explanation: A tank's main gun sits in a turret, and castles have turret towers.

lines.CASTLE: A turret is a small tower on a castle wall.
lines.TANK: A tank's turret rotates to aim the gun.

hints.explanation: Chef Gordon Ramsay hosts the TV show Hell's Kitchen.

lines.CHEF: Gordon Ramsay is a famous chef.
lines.HELL: Ramsay's cooking show is Hell's Kitchen.

hints.explanation: Clark Griswold leads his family through National Lampoon's Vacation and Christmas Vacation.

lines.CHRISTMAS: In Christmas Vacation, Clark covers his house in Christmas lights.
lines.VACATION: Clark Griswold drives his family cross-country in Vacation.

hints.explanation: A French press brews coffee, and French roast is a dark coffee roast.

lines.COFFEE: French roast is a dark-roasted coffee.
lines.PRESS: A French press steeps grounds and then presses them down with a plunger.

hints.explanation: Captain Cook was a real explorer, and Captain Hook is Peter Pan's pirate foe.

lines.COOK: Captain James Cook explored the Pacific in the 1700s.
lines.HOOK: Captain Hook is the pirate captain in Peter Pan.

hints.explanation: Miss Universe is a beauty pageant, and its winner is crowned.

lines.CROWN: Pageant winners are crowned at the end of the show.
lines.UNIVERSE: Miss Universe is an international beauty pageant.

hints.explanation: A PhD is a doctoral degree, and people who hold one can be called Doctor.

lines.DEGREE: A PhD is an advanced research degree.
lines.DOCTOR: PhD holders can be addressed as Doctor.

hints.explanation: In the Sound of Music song Do-Re-Mi, doe and ray are puns on the notes do and re.

lines.DOE: In the song, doe, the word for a female deer, is a pun on the note do.
lines.RAY: In the song, ray stands in for the note re.

hints.explanation: In How to Train Your Dragon, Hiccup is a young Viking who befriends the dragon Toothless.

lines.VIKING: Hiccup is a Viking boy from Berk.

hints.explanation: A hide is an animal's skin, and drummers call drumheads skins.

lines.DRUM: Drumheads are often called skins, and some are made of hide.
lines.HIDE: An animal's hide is its skin.

hints.explanation: The Chunnel, or Channel Tunnel, runs under the English Channel between England and France.

lines.ENGLAND: The Chunnel links England and France by rail.
lines.TUNNEL: Chunnel is the nickname of the Channel Tunnel.

hints.explanation: An hourglass figure is a body shape, and an hourglass measures time with sand.

lines.FIGURE: An hourglass figure is curvy with a narrow waist.
lines.SAND: Sand trickles through an hourglass to mark time.

hints.explanation: A tag sale and a garage sale are the same thing: selling used things from home.

lines.GARAGE: A garage sale sells household items, often from the garage or driveway.
lines.TAG: A tag sale is a home sale of used items.

hints.explanation: On an African safari, visitors watch giraffes on the savanna.

lines.GIRAFFE: Giraffes browse acacia trees on the African savanna.
lines.SAFARI: Many African safaris cross the savanna.

hints.explanation: The Parthenon is an ancient temple to Athena on the Acropolis in Athens, Greece.

lines.GREECE: The Parthenon stands on the Acropolis in Athens, Greece.
lines.TEMPLE: The Parthenon was built as a temple to the goddess Athena.

hints.explanation: Miners wear helmets fitted with a lamp.

lines.HELMET: A miner's helmet often has a headlamp.
lines.LAMP: A miner's lamp lights the tunnel.

hints.explanation: Bollywood, the Hindi film industry of India, takes its name from Bombay and Hollywood.

lines.HOLLYWOOD: The name Bollywood is a play on Hollywood.
lines.INDIA: Bollywood is based in Mumbai, formerly called Bombay.

hints.explanation: Pinocchio is a wooden puppet who wants to become a real, human boy.

lines.HUMAN: Pinocchio dreams of being a real boy.
lines.PUPPET: Pinocchio is a puppet carved by Geppetto.

hints.explanation: The Crown Jewels are kept in the Tower of London.

lines.JEWEL: The Crown Jewels are on display in London.
lines.TOWER: The Tower of London is a historic castle on the Thames.

hints.explanation: Test tubes are used in labs, where scientists run tests.

lines.LAB: Labs run tests, often with test tubes.
lines.TUBE: A test tube is a small glass tube.

hints.explanation: XL is the size label for extra large, often seen on shirts.

lines.SHIRT: XL is a common shirt size.

hints.explanation: In stories, a time machine lets you time travel.

lines.MACHINE: H. G. Wells wrote The Time Machine.
lines.TRAVEL: Time travel is a classic sci-fi idea.

hints.explanation: Michelangelo carved his David from marble, and a Ninja Turtle is named after him.

lines.MARBLE: Michelangelo carved David from a single block of marble.
lines.TURTLE: Michelangelo is the orange-masked Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtle.

hints.explanation: Master Splinter, the Ninja Turtles' teacher, is a rat, and a splinter is also a sliver of wood.

lines.MASTER: The Turtles call their teacher Master Splinter.

hints.explanation: Ford built the Model T and sells the popular F-150 truck.

lines.MODEL: The Model T was Ford's famous early car.
lines.TRUCK: Ford's F-150 is a popular pickup truck.

hints.explanation: The Louvre museum in Paris has a famous glass pyramid entrance.

lines.MUSEUM: The Louvre is a famous art museum in Paris.
lines.PYRAMID: The Louvre's main entrance is a glass pyramid.

hints.explanation: Spider-Man's Peter Parker sells photos to the Daily Bugle newspaper.

lines.NEWSPAPER: The Daily Bugle is the newspaper in Spider-Man stories.
lines.SPIDER: Peter Parker, Spider-Man, takes photos for the Bugle.

hints.explanation: A slumber party is a sleepover where friends wear pajamas.

lines.PAJAMAS: Pajamas are what you slumber in.
lines.PARTY: A slumber party is a sleepover party.

hints.explanation: A tennis server can hit an ace, and a top fighter pilot is called an ace.

lines.PILOT: A flying ace is a pilot with many aerial victories.
lines.SERVER: In tennis, an ace is a serve the receiver can't touch.

hints.explanation: Pepperoni is a spicy cured sausage and a favorite pizza topping.

lines.PIZZA: Pepperoni is a favorite pizza topping in the U.S.
lines.SAUSAGE: Pepperoni is a type of dry-cured sausage.

hints.explanation: The bench press is a classic weightlifting exercise done on a weight bench.

lines.PRESS: The bench press pushes a barbell up from the chest.
lines.WEIGHT: Lifters use a weight bench for many exercises.

hints.explanation: The mute button on a remote cuts the volume.

lines.VOLUME: Muting turns the volume all the way off.

hints.explanation: A root canal is a dental treatment inside a tooth's root.

lines.ROOT: A root canal cleans out the inside of a tooth's root.
lines.TOOTH: A dentist may perform a root canal to save an infected tooth.

hints.explanation: Trains stop at a station platform, and platform shoes have thick soles.

lines.SHOE: Platform shoes have a thick raised sole.
lines.STATION: Passengers wait on the platform at a train station.

hints.explanation: Ticks and spiders are both arachnids.

lines.TICK: Ticks are arachnids, like spiders and scorpions.

hints.explanation: Border officers may stamp a traveler's passport.

lines.STAMP: Passport stamps record entries into a country.
lines.TRAVEL: International travel usually requires a passport.

hints.explanation: Silkworms spin silk, which is made into thread.

lines.THREAD: Silk thread comes from silkworm cocoons.
lines.WORM: Silkworms are caterpillars, named worms, that spin silk cocoons.
